description: Ranked blocks retain cycle ancestry when an outside captured query restores omitted terminators (engine §4 and §10).
grammar:
%rule text $x:X %conditions Recursive ⊆ $x.tags(r), $x.tags(q) = ∅

%rule q $y:r %conditions ¬($y.without-elision.matches(rival))

%rule r sealed :: Recursive | X :: ∅
%rule sealed :: ∅ | ((r [+U]) ≻ Y)

%rule rival X
